name: Spanish Kings
description: Puerto Rican street gang that emerged in Chicago's West Town and Humboldt Park neighborhoods in the early 1960s. On December 4, 1962, Chicago Police broke up a rumble between the Spanish Kings, Chi-West, and the Latin Angels at Chopin School Playground. The Latin Kings attempted to work alongside them in the mid-1960s but dismantled their East Humboldt Park faction in 1966. A separate South Chicago faction remained active through the late 1970s before disbanding around 1979, with former members going on to co-found the Puerto Rican Latin Stones.
